What is Bojin Therapy?

Bojin Therapy is a Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) technique that targets deeper tissues and works along meridian points to release deep-seated tension and chronic pain. This form of therapy has the added benefit of releasing emotional tension, as you feel lighter and better when your energy is flowing well again. During Bojin therapy, deep targeted pressure is applied to energy points to release tension and blockages, restore circulation and enhance Qi (vital energy) flow.
Complements Massage

Bojin complements traditional massage techniques because it can penetrate deeper layers of muscle and break through meridian blockages that standard massages may not reach. While traditional massage improves overall circulation, energy flow and relaxation across the body, Bojin specifically focuses on releasing deep-seated knots and tension points in stubborn areas like the shoulders, neck, and lower back, providing more targeted and lasting relief.

blocks.text: How Does Ginseng Bojin Meridian Massage Work?
blocks.html: How Does Ginseng Bojin Meridian Massage Work?

A key principle In TCM states that “不通则痛, 痛则不通” which translates to “If the body has blockages, there will be pain. Bojin Meridian Massage blends TCM meridian therapy with Western science knowledge of muscle structure to target blockages accurately.

  • Uses special tools made from buffalo horn to activate specific meridian points on the body or face.
  • The special tools enable us to apply pressure precisely to unlock knots in deep tissues. This is similar to breaking down scar tissue to reduce pain and improve movement.
  • When blockages are cleared, energy and blood can circulate healthily. Injured or “dull” muscles are activated, and recovery begins.
  • TCM believes that Qi flows through meridian channels related to your organs, if they have blockages, you may suffer symptoms and affect your well-being. Hence clearing blockages help maintain health and vitality.
  • To enhance the healing effects of Bojin therapy, we incorporate a nourishing Ginseng cream into the treatment. Ginseng, a prized herb in TCM, is known for its powerful anti-aging, anti-inflammatory, and revitalizing properties. This botanical infusion works in harmony with Bojin techniques to improve energy or “Qi” flow and restore balance.

Frequently Ask Question

What are the techniques used in Ginseng Bojin Meridian Therapy?

This therapy uses a buffalo horn tool to apply targeted pressure and scraping movements along meridian channels and acupressure points. It helps release muscle knots, improve Qi (energy) flow, and enhance circulation for overall wellness.

Who is this therapy suitable for?

This therapy is ideal for individuals experiencing chronic muscle pain, tension, fatigue, poor circulation, or those looking for natural wellness and anti-aging benefits. It is also suitable for people with active lifestyles who need deep muscle recovery.

Is Ginseng Bojin Meridian Therapy painful?

The treatment involves deep pressure and scraping techniques, which may cause some discomfort, especially for those with tight muscles. However, our therapists adjust the pressure based on your comfort level.

Are there any side effects or aftercare tips?

Some individuals may experience mild redness or tenderness after the session, which usually subsides within a day. It is recommended to drink plenty of water and avoid strenuous activities for the next 24 hours.

Why is Bojin able to reach such deep tissue layers?

The buffalo horn tool is uniquely shaped and designed for deep tissue release. Due to its hardness and resonance with the body’s frequencies, it is believed to enhance the therapy’s effectiveness, improving muscle elasticity, joint mobility, and overall relaxation.
